Prefer tests-only changes. Modify src/aios_renew/operator.py or src/aios_renew/review_transport.py only if one of the new regressions exposes a real fail-closed defect. Preserve the existing TASK-058 semantic contract, current-head REPAIR compatibility, TASK-057 completion authority, one-executor/no-retry policy, downstream isolation, and frozen schemas.
finding.issue: The candidate implements multiple fail-closed historical-lineage gates, but the deterministic regression proof required by AC4 is incomplete. Existing TASK-058 revision-2 regressions prove the positive RUN-125 remediation-to-successful-source topology, failed-head/failure-identity rejection, remote duplicate continuation rejection, historical TASK retrieval, and invalid TASK path rejection. They do not deterministically exercise at least cyclic failed continuation lineage, historical TASK/revision mismatch, reviewed-SHA mismatch at the failed REMEDIATION-to-successful-source boundary, unauthorized/conflicting legacy REPAIR authorization, or ambiguous reviewed successful-source lineage. AC4 explicitly requires regressions for these rejection classes before historical workspace mutation or Executor invocation, so passing implementation code alone is not sufficient evidence for this acceptance criterion.
